definitions.gloss: various circumstances; various reasons; a number of factors
definitions.explanation: Refers to multiple reasons or circumstances, often used when the speaker does not wish to specify the exact details.

examples.japanese: {諸事情|しょじじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}します→中止する：21909_chuushisuru⟧。
examples.english: It will be canceled due to various circumstances.

examples.japanese: {諸事情|しょじじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can't participate due to various reasons.

examples.japanese: {諸事情|しょじじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考慮|こうりょ}した→考慮する：06061_kouryosuru⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: As a result of considering various circumstances, it was decided to change the plan.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{諸|しょ}→諸〜：03956_sho⟧ (various, many) + ⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧ (circumstances, reasons). This word is commonly used in formal or semi-formal contexts when the speaker wants to cite reasons without going into specifics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諸事情|しょじじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧: due to various circumstances
- {諸事情|しょじじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧: because of various reasons
- {諸事情|しょじじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考慮|こうりょ}して→考慮する：06061_kouryosuru⟧: taking various circumstances into account
- {諸事情|しょじじょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from various circumstances

USAGE:
Often functions as a polite way to avoid giving a specific reason. In announcements, it serves as a catch-all explanation for cancellations, delays, or changes. In everyday speech, it can be a tactful way to decline an invitation or explain a decision without revealing personal details.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧: circumstances — singular or general; {諸事情|しょじじょう} emphasizes that there are multiple factors
- ⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧: convenience/circumstances — more personal and informal
